title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker Styled Dolphins
description:
Hey, small fry! Venturing alone in the Great Sea and want some neat dolphin graphics? Fear not, with these Fishmen reskins of the dolphin sprite, your sea-themed levels will be even more fun. Aye.

Credits should go to No Body The Dragon.
